title: Rational homology disk degenerations of elliptic surfaces
summary: In this paper, a $\mathbb{Q}$HD singularity is a weighted homogeneous normal surface singularity admitting a rational homology disk ($\mathbb{Q}$HD) smoothing. These singularities are rational but often not log canonical. We classify all $\mathbb{Q}$HD degenerations of nonsingular projective elliptic surfaces, extending Kawamata's classification of the case with only Wahl singularities (i.e., log terminal $\mathbb{Q}$HD singularities).
